tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Resolves a named AI company to stable IDs, names and descriptions. Revenue-only records can have null catalog slug and profile URL; their returned ID remains usable for company lookup. Matches depend on spelling and available aliases; no matches do not prove a language is unsupported or a company do

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Returns public data for an exact company ID or slug. Company and product soc2Disclosure states are separately reported_claims or unknown_not_disclosed, with original vendor claim statuses rather than independent certification. Available dimensions: profile, products, compliance, customers, deploymen

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: Lists supported industries with canonical IDs/slugs, names, descriptions and aliases. Includes cross-industry, consumer and agent audiences when available. An optional query filters this directory; without it the directory is browsable with pagination.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Lists AI solution task IDs, slugs, descriptions and company coverage, optionally within an industry. An optional query filters the directory. Ambiguous 'AI verification platform', 'verification' and 'verify' queries include clarification_required with identities/KYC, document authenticity and factua

tools.name: get_solution_rankings
tools.description: Returns published AI solution rankings for a specified industry/task. Industry only returns its task directory and cross-industry links; industry + task selects that exact scope; task only selects cross-industry. Missing entities/combinations return normal not_found results with discovery guidance,

tools.name: list_company_leaderboards
tools.description: List supported AI company leaderboards by annual revenue, country/region and category. Returns IDs, scope, descriptions and source URLs. Country lists rank companies within a geography; they do not rank countries.

tools.name: get_company_leaderboard
tools.description: Returns a published AI company leaderboard by its exact ID, e.g. ai-global, ai-usa or ai-china. Includes ranks and ties, revenue in USD, reporting basis, period, confidence and original sources. Revenue, ARR, run-rate, forecasts and estimates have distinct basis labels.

tools.name: list_research_domains
tools.description: Lists AI research fields with canonical slugs and descriptions, such as NLP, computer vision, agents/tool use and RAG. These are research domains, separate from commercial company industries. An optional query filters the domain directory.

tools.name: search_research
tools.description: Searches research benchmarks, datasets, tasks or papers using keywords, benchmark/dataset names, paper titles, authors or arXiv identifiers. Returns 20 results per API page. Versions, test splits and Full/Hard variants can be separate benchmarks. Search summaries are discovery data, not validated pe

tools.name: get_research_entity
tools.description: Returns one exact research entity. Dataset identifiers are dataset-FAMILY slugs (e.g. omnidocbench), not version slugs (e.g. omnidocbench-v1-5); family details include benchmarks across versions. Task/domain identifiers are canonical slugs; paper identifiers are 24-character paper IDs rather than ar

tools.name: get_research_benchmark
tools.description: Returns individual reported result rows for one exact benchmark version/split and metric. Top N corresponds to limit N rows, each identified by resultId with exact method, configuration and global position, including ties. Rows are not deduplicated or grouped into method families.
